title: S3 startup probe at bucket root, not under prefix — fails if bucket policy restricts writes to prefix/*
description: Trigger: operator sets backend.s3.prefix = 'stoa/prod' and has a bucket IAM policy that only allows PutObject on 'stoa/*'. The startup probe PUTs '_stoa_write_probe' at the bucket root (not 'stoa/prod/_stoa_write_probe'), which is denied by the policy. The startup probe fails with a permissions error even though the configured prefix is fully accessible. Operator sees 'startup probe failed' and cannot distinguish a misconfigured prefix from a real permissions problem. Fix: probe path should be OPath::from(format\!('{}/_stoa_write_probe', self.prefix)) so it exercises the actual access path.
